_note: ClimbMix m1 (the v1 m1 cluster weights, alpha 0.5) at 200B Llama-3.1 tokens for Llama3 R3/R4 TPP100. Every cluster continues the v1 stream after the v1 validation documents, so the v1 50B training documents are the start of pass e0; clusters whose quota exceeds their documents are read again (13 clusters, up to ~3.35 passes, ~23B repeated tokens). The last val_tail_tokens_per_cluster of every cluster (never read by the v1 50B build) are held out as the per-group validation sets; val/all is the v1 val_all, unchanged.
name: climbmix_m1_200b
